The Truth About Your Namkeen

The big brands
switched to cheaper oil.
We never did.

When Haldiram's and Bikaji scaled up, they quietly switched from mustard oil to refined palm and sunflower oil. Cost savings. Longer shelf life. More profit.

We use Kachi Ghani mustard oil — cold-pressed, unrefined, exactly as traditional UP namkeen was always made.

Our Story

From Muzaffarnagar,
with no shortcuts.

We started Hariram because we were tired of settling — tired of namkeen that tasted like it was made in a machine by someone who'd never eaten it.

UP has a real namkeen tradition. Mustard oil, fresh spices, slow cooking — that's what it tastes like when it's done right. The big brands knew this once. Then they grew, and the oil changed first.

We're FSSAI licensed. We're live. We're growing. But what we cook in will never change.
